FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Military Backend Changes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Handful of changes to the military backend for submod support.

patchNoteLines.li: Add RaidWeightRegistry and associated interface, for submods to influence the raid weighting for Empire settlements
Add UnitOverlayRegistry and associated interface, for submods to add information to the military squad screen
Add MercenaryDeathEvent, for submods to potentially intercept mercenary deaths

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: "Ghost" Caravan Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a couple of issues that might cause "Ghost" caravans

patchNoteLines.li: If a delivery good can't be added to a pawn for some reason, then it is placed at the tax spot, instead of silently destroyed
Tax delivery method is locked in at event creation time, rather than delivery time

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Resource-DLC Patch
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a DLC-access issue for some resources.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: Deathrest capacity serum and Sentience catalyst on RTD_Medicine weren't gated behind DLC checks, causing problems for players without those DLC
Updated several other items to also check for DLC

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Biotech fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A couple of fixes to let Empire gracefully handle not having Biotech.

patchNoteLines.li: Gate xenotype initialization behind a check for the Biotech DLC
Don't render the xenotype filter button if Biotech is disabled/not intalled, and there is only one humanlike race

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Policy Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes an issue where some policies wouldn't properly apply until restarting the game.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: Militaristic and Expansionist policies wouldn't correctly apply their bonuses until restarting the game

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Some minor fixes to make the road builder a little more robust.

patchNoteLines.li: Make sure that the settlement list is populated before processing paths

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Handful of minor fixes for unit importing and xenotype handling.

patchNoteLines.li: Detect when an imported unit encountered errors during loading, and mark it in the Import Units UI
Patch out references to "Xenotypes" in the Manage Units window when Biotech isn't active

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds a couple more DLC checks for DLC-using code.

patchNoteLines.li: Gates two code uses of shuttles behind checks for the Royalty DLC, with a fallback option to transport pods or regular caravans
